summary: Adapter is stateless and requires the strict Skill input gate; preparation blocks hidden state, shell execution, missing slice, or absent contract_hash/validator_hash (RMAP-PREPARE-INVALID, RMAP-CMD-SHELL, RMAP-HASH-AUTHORITY); RED requires prepared state, declared failure, nonzero exit, and tests/docs-only changes; GREEN requires observed RED, zero exit, and production-path changes; REFACTOR requires observed GREEN, zero exit, and declared production/tests/docs write set; invalid transitions block with RMAP-TDD-RED-NOT-OBSERVED or RMAP-TDD-EXIT-PROOF; finalization accepts only exact RED-GREEN-REFACTOR lifecycle and remains non-authoritative; resume requires identical identities and successor for failed/stale/superseded runs; stage binding validates capsule-attempt bundle schema, unique stage context/attempt, matching IDs/hashes, and empty authorizations; protocol persistence validates artifacts, containment, no reparse points, immutable conflicts, and declared existing files, writing non-decision artifacts before decisions; execute rejects existing run directories, requires bundle/store together, persists recovery-state.v1 with hashes, stages, and no authorizations.
